notes.md: - **Nandalal Bose:** led the team of Santiniketan artists that **illustrated the original handwritten Constitution of India**; the calligraphy was by **Prem Behari Narain Raizada**.
- **Raja Ravi Varma** (Kilimanoor, Travancore): set up the **Ravi Varma Fine Art Lithographic Press** at **Bombay in 1894**, which spread his prints of gods and epics across India.
